topic.title: Margin-Based Learning and Support Vector Models
topic.overview: Support vector methods organize classification around separating classes with a margin. The represented work studies sparse support sets, local linear models, indefinite kernels, scalable approximations, and connections to learned deep features. The classifier’s geometry and its computational representation are closely linked.
topic.whyItMatters: A large support set can make prediction expensive even when training succeeds. At the same time, a margin is only useful in a feature space that captures relevant distinctions, motivating both theoretical bounds and joint representation learning.
topic.evolution: Early examples construct boundary-focused radial-basis models and simplify support-vector decisions. Later papers address kernel validity, efficient prediction, and optimal sparsity. Recent work revisits high-dimensional optimization and lets an SVM boundary guide deep feature updates. This broadens the use of margin geometry beyond a fixed final classifier without making classical and deep formulations identical.
openQuestions: How can sparse prediction retain useful margins under distribution shift?
When does joint feature–margin optimization improve over a strong fixed representation?

papers.tldr: Learned tree-structured features greatly reduce nonlinear SVM prediction costs, with a moderate accuracy sacrifice in reported RBF-SVM comparisons.

papers.title: Multi-Class Classification with Maximum Margin Multiple Kernel
papers.tldr: M^3K learns with multiple kernels by maximizing a multiclass margin linked theoretically to accurate prediction.

papers.title: Safe Screening of Non-Support Vectors in Pathwise SVM Computation
papers.tldr: Safe screening removes some non-support vectors before pathwise SVM training and often substantially reduces total computation.

papers.title: Vanishing Component Analysis
papers.tldr: Vanishing Component Analysis learns compact polynomial descriptions of nonlinear data structure, yielding smaller classifiers with accuracy comparable to kernel methods in experiments.

papers.title: A Divide-and-Conquer Solver for Kernel Support Vector Machines
papers.tldr: DC-SVM uses clustered subproblems to accelerate kernel SVM training and provide useful predictions before global optimization finishes.

papers.title: Linear Time Solver for Primal SVM
papers.tldr: An augmented-Lagrangian primal SVM solver uses parallelizable matrix-vector operations and reports faster average performance than evaluated alternatives.

papers.title: On Robustness and Regularization of Structural Support Vector Machines
papers.tldr: Specified feature-perturbation models for structural SVMs are equivalent to additional regularizers, with empirical benefits under distribution shift.

papers.title: Outlier Path: A Homotopy Algorithm for Robust SVM
papers.tldr: Outlier Path gradually reduces outlier influence while tracking robust SVM solutions, supporting efficient tuning and empirically better local solutions.

papers.title: Scaling SVM and Least Absolute Deviations via Exact Data Reduction
papers.tldr: Safe screening rules remove irrelevant training examples before SVM or least absolute deviations optimization, with reported speedups up to two orders of magnitude.

papers.title: Bayesian Nonlinear Support Vector Machines and Discriminative Factor Modeling
papers.tldr: A Bayesian nonlinear SVM enables joint feature and classifier learning within factor models, with experiments supporting accuracy and interpretability benefits.

papers.title: Large-Margin Convex Polytope Machine
papers.tldr: The Convex Polytope Machine learns a nonlinear enclosure for one class, with substantially faster training and competitive accuracy in reported experiments.

papers.title: Classification with Low Rank and Missing Data
papers.tldr: Under a low-rank data assumption, an efficient non-proper learning formulation provides classification guarantees against predictors with access to complete data.

papers.title: Support Matrix Machines
papers.tldr: Support matrix machines use a convex matrix-aware penalty that tends to select correlated rows or columns together.

papers.title: Multi-class SVMs: From Tighter Data-Dependent Generalization Bounds to Novel Algorithms
papers.tldr: A tighter multiclass generalization bound motivates an lp-regularized classifier that achieves accuracy gains on several real-world benchmarks.

papers.title: Top-k Multiclass SVM
papers.tldr: A multiclass SVM trained with a convex surrogate for top-k error consistently improves top-k accuracy across five evaluated datasets.

papers.title: Minding the Gaps for Block Frank-Wolfe Optimization of Structured SVMs
papers.tldr: Block-gap estimates guide adaptive sampling, update variants, caching, and regularization-path computation for structured-SVM optimization.

papers.title: The Teaching Dimension of Linear Learners
papers.tldr: The paper derives minimum teaching-set sizes and matching optimal examples for ridge regression, support vector machines, and logistic regression.

papers.title: Large Margin Discriminant Dimensionality Reduction in Prediction Space
papers.tldr: LADDER jointly learns a compact data representation and linear classifiers using a shared large-margin view of boosting and SVMs.

papers.title: Multi-Class Optimal Margin Distribution Machine
papers.tldr: mcODM efficiently optimizes multiclass margin distributions and outperforms four multiclass SVM variants across all reported experimental datasets.

papers.title: Equivalence of Multicategory SVM and Simplex Cone SVM: Fast Computations and Statistical Theory
papers.tldr: An exact equivalence links interpretable multicategory SVMs to efficient simplex-cone computation and supports a new variance-weighted classifier.

papers.title: But How Does It Work in Theory? Linear SVM with Random Features
papers.tldr: Under low-noise assumptions, an optimized random-feature SVM can achieve fast classification learning rates with far fewer features than training examples.

papers.title: Learning Confidence Sets using Support Vector Machines
papers.tldr: A support-vector method learns class confidence sets while controlling non-coverage and reducing ambiguous overlap with high probability.

papers.title: Growing Adaptive Multi-hyperplane Machines
papers.tldr: Growing AMM adds hyperplanes during training to improve nonlinear classification accuracy with a modest training-time increase.

papers.title: Near-Tight Margin-Based Generalization Bounds for Support Vector Machines
papers.tldr: Improved generalization bounds and a nearly matching lower bound sharply characterize support vector machine performance in terms of margins.

papers.title: The Performance Analysis of Generalized Margin Maximizers on Separable Data
papers.tldr: Generalized Margin Maximizers extend maximum-margin classification to arbitrary convex objectives and enable precise performance analysis for structured models.

papers.title: Weston-Watkins Hinge Loss and Ordered Partitions
papers.tldr: The paper proves that Weston-Watkins hinge loss is calibrated to a new ordered partition loss and uses this theory to explain observed robustness to heavy label noise.

papers.title: An exact solver for the Weston-Watkins SVM subproblem
papers.tldr: An exact solver for a recurring Weston-Watkins SVM subproblem speeds linear multiclass training and enables a geometric convergence proof.

papers.title: Improved Learning Rates of a Functional Lasso-type SVM with Sparse Multi-Kernel Representation
papers.tldr: The paper derives improved convergence guarantees for sparse multi-kernel SVMs under conditions involving complexity, sparsity, and sample size.

papers.title: Support vector machines and linear regression coincide with very high-dimensional features
papers.tldr: The paper characterizes the dimensional threshold where every example becomes a support vector, connecting SVMs with minimum-norm regression.

papers.title: A Consolidated Cross-Validation Algorithm for Support Vector Machines via Data Reduction
papers.tldr: A consolidated cross-validation method uses data reduction to train and tune kernel SVMs roughly ten times faster in numerical studies, with almost unchanged accuracy.

papers.title: Implicit Regularization in Over-Parameterized Support Vector Machine
papers.tldr: An over-parameterized, smoothed SVM achieves near-oracle statistical convergence without explicit regularization under appropriate optimization choices.

papers.title: Finite Smoothing Algorithm for High-Dimensional Support Vector Machines and Quantile Regression
papers.tldr: FSA smooths difficult loss functions to accelerate high-dimensional SVM and quantile-regression optimization while retaining the ability to obtain exact solutions.

papers.title: Deep Principal Support Vector Machines for Nonlinear Sufficient Dimension Reduction
papers.tldr: The paper extends principal support vector machine ideas with neural networks for flexible nonlinear dimension reduction backed by statistical analysis.

papers.title: DDSVM: A Differentiable Framework for Deep Support Vector Machines with Iterative Geometry-Aware Optimization
papers.tldr: DDSVM repeatedly feeds SVM margin geometry back into a neural feature extractor, reducing classification error under data scarcity.
